repairs.correction: 아래 ruleChecks에 기록된 최종 조건·대상·단위로 최소 수정; before 원본과 candidate 비교 가능
repairs.quote: Milio kicks a fireball, Knocking Back the first enemy hit. If it hits, the ball bounces past them and explodes, dealing (80/140/200/260/320 + (120% Ability Power)) magic damage to surrounding enemies and Slowing them by (40/45/50/55/60% + (5% per 100 Ability Power)) for 1.5 seconds. Hitting at least one enemy champion with Ultra Mega Fire Kick refunds 50% of it's Mana cost. Minions and monsters are knocked further and create a larger explosion.
